groups.defect: The async legacy Create goroutine (lines 50-57) builds its timeout context from the request context. The legacy write is therefore canceled once the handler returns, so it does not survive the response. s_0469979e adds that the Delete, Update and DeleteCollection goroutines have the same problem.

answer.reasoning: Both suggestions point at the same lines (50-57) and report the same defect: the background legacy Create uses a context derived from the request, so it gets canceled when the response returns. Both propose the same fix, which is to detach the context from request cancellation while keeping the values it needs. That makes them a same_location duplicate. The two judges only disagree on needsUnifiedComment. s_0469979e already says everything s_faba93e0 says, including the note to apply the fix to the Delete, Update and DeleteCollection paths. s_faba93e0 is a strict subset of it and adds nothing. So posting s_0469979e alone covers the whole group, and no merged comment has to say more than one member already says. needsUnifiedComment is false.
